events.name: Oh, Mary! (Touring)
events.info: Oh, Mary! is a dark comedy about a miserable, suffocated Mary Todd Lincoln in the weeks leading up to Abraham Lincoln's assassination. Unrequited yearning, alcoholism, and suppressed desires abound in this 80-minute one-act play that finally examines the forgotten life and dreams of Mrs. Lincoln, through the lens of an idiot (playwright Cole Escola). Declared "one of the best comedies in years" by The New York Times, Oh, Mary! received two Tony Awards including Best Direction of a Play (Sam Pinkleton), Drama League Awards for Outstanding Play and Outstanding Direction of a Play, as well as a special citation from the New York Drama Critics' Circle. It was named a finalist for the Pulitzer Prize for Drama.

events.info: Comedians Enya Umanzor and Drew Phillips overshare their lives on the trailblazing podcast Emergency Intercom. With tasteful comedic timing, the two discuss even the most personal of subjects in a way that allows listeners to relate, touching on anything from housing troubles and making friends, to seasonal depression, to the everyday annoyances of life. They can also be found on iHeart, YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and Patreon.

Swing-out arm aisle Transfer seats available in Orchestra level for mobility impaired patrons. Assisted Listening Devices available in Lobby for each performance on first-come, first-serve basis. Select performances may offer ASL or Audio-described services.

generalInfo.generalRule: No cameras, video or audio recording. Please be considerate to other patrons & refrain from cell phone use during shows. Late seating only at appropriate break. No outside food or beverages allowed
generalInfo.childRule: All ages must have their own ticket in same section as parent / adult. Please be considerate & use discretion when bringing young children to any theatre event.
